models.name: Bonsai 2 27B
models.storage_offload: expert layers offloaded to CPU/SSD on 4GB-VRAM machines

engines.hardware: 4GB VRAM + 32GB system RAM (MoE/quantized build, partial offload)
engines.quant: quantized-down Ternary Bonsai 2 27B / Qwen3.8-27B class build; llama-server print_timing slot lines tg 2.50 t/s (tg_3s 2.53), ~12 t/s prompt processing on a ~4K-token prompt
